methodology: 5 fresh host+worker processes per variant; rotated order; Wasmtime cold=empty private cache, warm=seeded cache; OS/Deno caches not flushed. Standard and compute retain their production fuel/yield/memory limits. 20 warmups per workload. RSS/PSS are module-worker-only; parent host memory/CPU recorded separately. No forced GC. CPU tick counters include memory sampling overhead; do not treat sub-tick changes as precise. Samples compare TS/Deno and Rust/WASM implementations plus SDK, not engines alone, and exclude CEF/renderer/GPU/index/PTY. Full language engines and large projects are not represented.
